about: Entries for CPUIDs the article has no row for, each fact with the page it came from. import.py appends them after the article's and refuses one whose CPUID the article has: the article's own row is kept. A model's codes are ARK's, in ark-sspec.json, placed by enrich.py. A stepping no source ties to the CPUID is left empty, not guessed.

evidence.quote: #define INTEL_ATOM_CRESTMONT		IFM(6, 0xB6) /* Grand Ridge */
The one row for 06_B6H is stepping 4, CPUID B0664 — none for B0660.
cpuB0664_plat01_ver00000030_2025-05-29_PRD_E618875A.bin — the one microcode of model 0xB6; none for B0660.

entries.note: The kernel names model 0xB6 Grand Ridge whatever its stepping. No source names a model sold as B0660: Intel's list of processors by CPUID, ARK's Grand Ridge models and the public microcode collections know only B0664. So the entry has no models, and none of B0664's are moved here.

evidence.quote: 06_B6H | 4 | … | Grand Ridge (Crestmont) | Intel® Atom® Processors P6000 series | Server | B0664 | 0x36
#define INTEL_ATOM_CRESTMONT		IFM(6, 0xB6) /* Grand Ridge */
Products formerly Grand Ridge: Atom P6952-3, P6942-3, P6962-3, P6962-5, P6942-5, P6922-3
Product Collection: Intel Atom® Processor P Series; Code Name: Products formerly Grand Ridge; Vertical Segment: Server

entries.note: Intel's list of processors by CPUID gives B0664 (model 0xB6, stepping ID 4) as Grand Ridge, Atom P6000 series. Every Grand Ridge code on ARK is stepping B0, but no Intel page loaded names the stepping of ID 4, so the entry has none. Intel's Linux microcode repository has no 06-b6-04 file (checked 2026-11-07).

evidence.quote: #define CPUID_RAPTORLAKE_A0		0xb0670
#define INTEL_RAPTORLAKE		IFM(6, 0xB7) /* Raptor Cove / Enhanced Gracemont */
06_B7H rows: stepping 1, B0671 (Raptor Lake S; Catlow) — none for B0670.
cpuB0670_plat02_ver0000000E_2022-02-20_PRD_0A83935A.bin — revision 0x0E, platform 0x02, no extended signature table.

entries.note: coreboot names B0670 Raptor Lake A0; the kernel names model 0xB7 Raptor Lake. No source names a model sold as B0670: Intel's list of processors by CPUID has only B0671 for 06_B7H, and the one public microcode for B0670 (revision 0x0E) is dated 2022-02-20, months before Raptor Lake's launch. So the entry has no models.

evidence.quote: | BTL-S816       | B0       | 06-b7-04/36 |          | 00000137 | Intel Core Series 2 Processors with P-cores
cpuB0674_plat36_ver00000137_2026-02-18_PRD_FF5416E9.bin — extended signatures B0671/36, B0674/36, D0670/36

entries.note: Intel's microcode notes name 06-b7-04 BTL-S816, stepping B0, one update with B0671 and D0670. ARK lists Bartlett Lake models on B0 (Core 7 251E SRQDU, 251TE SRQAX, Core 5 221E SRQDV, 211E SRQER), but B0 is B0671's name too and no Intel document says which of the two CPUIDs they report, so none is listed. Intel's list of processors by CPUID has no B0674.

evidence.quote: 06_BAH | 2,3,8 | … | Raptor Lake P / H / U Refresh | … | Mobile | B06A2, B06A3, B06A8
cpuB06A8_platE0_ver00006134_2025-10-08_PRD_49EC5ADD.bin — extended signatures B06A2/E0, B06A3/E0, B06A8/E0

entries.note: Intel's list of processors by CPUID gives B06A8 with B06A2 (J0) and B06A3 (Q0) as Raptor Lake P/H/U Refresh; one microcode serves all three. No Intel document names its stepping — the 13th/14th gen datasheet (743844-015) and specification update (740518-032) list only B06A2 and B06A3 — so no model is listed.

evidence.quote: #define CPUID_LUNARLAKE_A0_1		0xb06d0
#define INTEL_LUNARLAKE_M		IFM(6, 0xBD) /* Lion Cove / Skymont */
06_BDH: stepping 1, Lunar Lake, Core Ultra 5, 7, 9, Mobile, CPUID B06D1 — none for B06D0.
cpuB06D0_plat80_ver0000001A_2024-06-10_PRD_D7BD1337.bin — revision 0x1A, platform 0x80, no extended signature table.

entries.note: Lunar Lake's stepping ID 0. No source names a model sold as B06D0: Intel's list of processors by CPUID has only B06D1 for 06_BDH, and its one public microcode (0x1A) is dated 2024-06-10, before Lunar Lake's launch. coreboot calls it A0, but also calls B06D1 "A0_2" where Intel's notes call it B0, so no stepping is written.

evidence.quote: #define CPUID_RAPTORLAKE_H0		0xb06f5
#define INTEL_RAPTORLAKE_S		IFM(6, 0xBF)

Each model's ARK ordering tab lists its codes at stepping H0 (ark-sspec.json); Code Name "Products formerly Raptor Lake", Vertical Segment "Desktop" (i3-13100, i3-14100, Processor 300), "Embedded" (i3-13100E)

entries.note: The article has no row for B06F5. Intel's microcode notes call 06-bf-05 RPL-S H0 since 2024 (earlier releases called it ADL C0); coreboot names 0xb06f5 Raptor Lake H0. The models are those whose ARK ordering tab gives an H0 code among the 13th/14th gen 4-core and 2-core desktop and embedded parts; the i5-13400/14400 (B0, C0) and Xeon E-2400 (B0) have none. Alder Lake's H0 is another CPUID, 90675.

evidence.quote: 06_BFH | 2, 5 | … | Raptor Lake S, Bartlett Lake S | … | Mobile, Embedded | B06F2, B06F5, B06F6, B06F7
cpuB06F6_plat07_ver0000003E_2025-10-12_PRD_5582AF1C.bin — extended signatures 90672, 90675, B06F2, B06F5, B06F6, B06F7 (07)

entries.note: Intel's list of processors by CPUID gives B06F6 with B06F2 (C0) and B06F5 (H0), Raptor Lake S and Bartlett Lake S; one microcode serves them and Alder Lake's 90672/90675. No Intel document names its stepping, so no model is listed.

evidence.quote: 06_BFH | 2, 5 | … | Raptor Lake S, Bartlett Lake S | … | Mobile, Embedded | B06F2, B06F5, B06F6, B06F7
cpuB06F7_plat07_ver0000003E_2025-10-12_PRD_5582AF1B.bin — extended signatures 90672, 90675, B06F2, B06F5, B06F6, B06F7 (07)

entries.note: As B06F6: Intel's list gives it with B06F2 and B06F5, Raptor Lake S and Bartlett Lake S; one microcode serves them; no Intel document names its stepping, so no model is listed.
